**客户端收到 `final` 必须调用 `EventSource.close()`**，否则浏览器会按 `retry:` 自动重连，
每次都再收到一份 snapshot + final。

caller's existing ancestor scopes that would make the candidate redundant

post.description:
Cancel one of the caller's index jobs (F2-a), owner-isolated like every other
job route: another owner's job_id looks like unknown (404), never a 403 oracle.

queued -> cancelled immediately (200).
running, no Qdrant mutation started yet -> a flag is set; the worker's mutation
fence observes it before its first write and settles the job as cancelled with
nothing committed (200 here — the transition itself happens asynchronously, so the
returned job may still show status=running for an instant).
running, mutation already started -> 409 {"code": "code_index_committing"}: a
partial write cannot be safely interrupted without leaving a half-committed scope.
already COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED -> 409 {"code": "code_index_already_ended"}.
Semantic code search over the caller's indexed chunks (path:line citations).

Search the caller's private Code KB and the curated Public Code corpus in one
fused ranking (RRF by default, or cross-encoder reranked with rerank=true).

The private leg always runs (R1, operator-confirmed 2026-09-23): there is no
include_private flag. ``projects`` scopes it (empty = every scope the caller
owns); an individually-withheld scope is excluded and reported in
``private.excluded_scopes`` rather than withholding the whole leg (decision 10).

Fail-closed, never a silent downgrade: include_public=true requires admin tier —
a non-admin caller gets 403 rather than a private-only result
(docs/federated_code_search_plan.md section 1). Both legs retrieve concurrently
with rerank=False; this route's own fusion (app.services.code_federation) decides
RRF vs rerank across the combined pool.

Report files in one indexed scope that duplicate each other.

Runs on a worker thread like search: a full scope scan issues one nearest-neighbour
query per chunk (~29s for 8.6k chunks in the reference measurement) and must not
occupy the event loop.

This is the explicit deletion path: a full re-index of an emptied tree is deliberately

post.description: Search one source, multiple sources, or domains as an internal/admin caller.

Declare a `git bundle` that will become a source's bare mirror.

Create the bundle from a clean clone with `git bundle create <file> HEAD <branch>`,
upload it with `PUT /imports/{import_id}/data`, then finish with
`POST /imports/{import_id}/complete`. Chunking, embedding and indexing run on the
server. An existing source must match source_id, domain, upstream_url,
relative_path and default_ref; a new one is registered when the import completes.
With private_project, the server reuses exact chunk vectors from the authenticated
creator's private Code KB scope; missing or changed chunks are embedded normally.

CodeIndexReport.title: CodeIndexReport
CodeIndexReport.description:
Index-inventory records the backend writes to the catalog WHEN THE JOB COMPLETES.

Bundling the report into the submit lets index_code fire-and-forget: the client
returns the job_id immediately instead of blocking on the embed just to report
afterwards. The write happens only on success (never optimistically — a failed job
must not leave the catalog claiming files are indexed that never landed).

incremental.title: Incremental
incremental.description: Only (re)embed the files in `files` and reconcile deletions against `manifest`, instead of wiping + rebuilding the whole project. The client sends only changed/new files' chunks.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: Incremental only: the full set of rel_paths that currently exist in the repo. Indexed files absent from it are deleted (removed-file reconciliation). None = don't delete anything, only add/update.

removed_paths.title: Removed Paths
removed_paths.description: Incremental only: exact repo-relative paths known to have been deleted. Filesystem watchers use this without enumerating a full manifest. Changed files in `files` take precedence over this list.

removed_paths_complete.title: Removed Paths Complete
removed_paths_complete.description: Incremental only: `removed_paths` lists EVERY file to delete, computed by the client against this scope's catalog inventory. The server then does not enumerate the project's paths in Qdrant to find removals; the delete-safety valve compares `manifest` with the catalog instead. Servers that predate the flag ignore it and reconcile `manifest` against Qdrant as before, so a client sends both.

report.description: Catalog inventory records to write to the index catalog once the job COMPLETES successfully. None = don't touch the catalog. This lets the client submit and return without blocking on the embed to report.

ScopeOverlapResponse.title: ScopeOverlapResponse
ScopeOverlapResponse.description:
Result of the nested-scope overlap check for a candidate index scope.

``ancestor_blocks``: existing parent scopes that ALREADY indexed a file under the
candidate → indexing the candidate child adds no coverage (the guard refuses it).
``child_warnings``: existing child scopes under the candidate → indexing the parent
proceeds but warns (it can add files outside the child).
``ancestor_widenings``: parent scopes that overlap the candidate but were indexed
with respect_gitignore ON while the candidate turns it OFF → the child reaches files
the parent provably never indexed, so it proceeds with a warning instead of a block.
All three are KB-scale conflict lists computed server-side, replacing a per-call
multi-MB inventory download.

SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
SearchResponse.description:
检索响应。

`results` 是命中 chunk 的扁平列表（向后兼容，`total_results == len(results)`）。
`papers` 是同一批 chunk 按论文分组后的视图（粒度=论文，按论文最高分排序）——
前端以 `papers` 为主渲染论文卡片。
